proposed_recipe.name: duckling_crest_puff
proposed_recipe.rationale: Plan phase 0: friendly duckling theme — a soft rounded crest tuft suggesting a hatchling's feather puff, matching the XGO Duck's rounded head shell seen in the renders. Compact base ellipse (~14x12x2.5 mm) stays well inside the 80x80x35 mm zone and light mass budget. Three tilted-back ellipsoid puffs (center plus bilateral pair) overlap the base positively; all rotated shapes keep lowest Z above 0 given centers >= ~3 mm with half-extents < ~3 mm. No fins or boxes, so no sharp or intimidating silhouettes. Camera lens on the front face and all source geometry untouched; attachment remains an unverified adhesive-pad proposal on the source triangle tangent.

findings: Build is host-eligible: proof accepted, motion passed at all 31 poses with min distance 16.8 mm, single fused solid, added mass 0.88 g — no floating or disconnected geometry in the CAD facts.
Close-up renders show the crest sits cleanly on the head-top rear slope, forward of the rear edge, and does not intrude on the camera lens or front dome in any of the four views.

Problem: at 14x12x2.5 base with 6-8 mm puffs, the part reads as a tiny yellow speck in the whole-robot views (barely visible in perspective and -Y view). It fails the brief's '有辨识度' (recognizable) requirement — the silhouette is too timid relative to the large head dome.

The three-puff 'duckling tuft' idea is coherent and friendly (no sharp edges), but at this scale it reads as a generic bump rather than a crest; the top view shows it as a small dot far from the head apex, weakening the identity claim.
No obstruction found: the part is far from the lens (front of head) and clear of all source geometry; zone compliance confirmed by bbox within 80x80x35 mm.

Revision direction: scale the puff cluster up modestly (center puff ~14x11x9 mm) and shift it closer to the head apex so it is clearly visible from front and side views, while keeping lowest-Z overlap with the 2.5 mm base and staying soft/rounded per the friendly brief.
Attachment remains an adhesive-pad proposal only; interface_status is unverified and walking/printability remain open, as the brief acknowledges.
review.reason: The candidate is structurally sound, connected and non-obstructive, and its friendly rounded styling matches the brief. However, the whole-robot renders show it is far too small and rear-placed to be recognizable as an identity feature on the XGO Duck's large head — it reads as a barely visible speck. A limited revision will enlarge and reposition the puff cluster for presence while preserving the accepted overlap, zone and motion-clearance margins.

proposed_recipe.name: duckling_crest_puff_mk2
proposed_recipe.rationale: Revision after round-0 needs-review (recipe 47de1147…): renders show the crest is host-eligible but reads as a tiny yellow speck far from the head apex. Fix: enlarge the puff cluster and broaden the base for presence. Base grows 14x12x2.5 -> 18x16x3; center puff grows to 16x13x11 at [0,0,5.5] tilted back -15deg (lowest Z ~5.5-5.4~0.1, inside base thickness with full XY overlap). Two side puffs (bilateral, Y=+4 only, host mirrors) at [-2.5,4,6] sized 10x6x7 tilted back -25deg keep lowest Z ~1.8mm>0 and overlap the base in XY. Total silhouette roughly doubles in apparent area while staying soft, rounded ellipsoids with no sharp edges; mass stays far under 16 g and the 18x16 footprint plus ~11 mm height sits well inside the 80x80x35 mm zone. Part stays rear-of-apex on the head-top slope, clear of the front camera lens and dome seen in the +X and perspective views. Adhesive-pad attachment, curvature fit, printability and walking remain open per the brief.

proposed_recipe.name: duckling_crest_puff_mk2b
proposed_recipe.rationale: Round-1 diagnosis: attempt-0 hit a null-shape CAD failure; attempt-1's recipe (47de lineage) was geometrically valid (all lowest-Z values positive and inside the 3 mm base: center puff ~+0.19 mm, side ~+1.4 mm, front ~+1.9 mm) but was rejected on a STEP-vs-CAD volume mismatch of ~0.8%, likely a tolerance/boolean artifact. Revision: resubmit the accepted enlarged friendly three-puff silhouette with slight size adjustments (center puff 15x12x10 at z=6.8, -10deg tilt, lowest Z ~0.1 mm fully inside the base; side puffs 10x6x7 at [-2.5,4,6], mirrored from Y>=0; front accent 7x5x5 at [4,3,5]) and a simpler rotation set to reduce boolean complexity. Renders confirm the round-0 crest was connected, clear of the camera lens and front dome, and merely too small; this keeps the doubled presence while staying soft, rounded and well inside 80x80x35 mm and 16 g. Adhesive attachment, curvature fit, printability and walking remain open per the brief.

findings: Whole-robot renders (perspective, -Y, +X, top) show the yellow two-puff crest sitting centered on the head-top dome, clearly visible and recognizable without obscuring the front camera lens or face dome.
Close-up renders confirm a soft, rounded, friendly silhouette; no sharp or intimidating edges, matching the brief.
Scale is compact: bbox ~18x16x11.8 mm, well inside the 80x80x35 mm zone; added mass ~2.15 g, far under budget; nothing implausibly large or obstructive.

Part is a single fused solid (solids: 1); center puff (15x12x10, -10 deg X tilt) and bilateral side puffs (10x6x7, -15 deg X tilt) all embed within the 3 mm base with positive-volume overlap; no floating geometry; no material below Z=0 (lowest feature Z ~+1.43 mm).
Build proof accepted (proof_accepted: true), motion check passed across 31 poses with minimum distance ~16.1 mm vs 0.2 mm tolerance; no collisions with original visible geometry.
CAD-vs-STEP volume discrepancy from round 1 resolved by simplifying to two ellipsoids with single-axis rotations; reported volume 1732.9 mm3 is consistent with the recipe digest.
Camera, electronics, shells and joints untouched; only one connected decorative part added on the fixed head-top datum.
Interface status remains unverified and adhesive attachment, curvature fit, printability and real walking performance are explicitly open, consistent with prototype-study framing.
review.reason: Round-2 candidate duckling_crest_puff_mk2c builds cleanly (proof accepted, single solid), passes sampled motion clearance, and the actual whole-robot and close-up renders show a friendly, recognizable rounded crest on the head top that preserves the XGO Duck identity and camera view. The prior volume-mismatch concern was addressed by simplifying geometry. Remaining unknowns (mount, fit, printing, gait) are declared open by the brief and do not block selection of this built, reviewed, eligible round.
